title: lathyrus sativus var. amphicarpos
intro: Lathyrus sativus var. amphicarpos, commonly known as the vetchling or narrow-leaved pea, is a variety of the Lathyrus sativus plant. It is a type of legume that belongs to the pea family and is native to the Indian subcontinent and other parts of Asia. The vetchling is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function, likely due to its therapeutic actions as a diuretic, laxative, and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus sativus var. amphicarpos include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
